an8.86:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena Icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma Kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tad avasari.
an8.86:1.2: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Icchānaṅgale viharati Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe. 2.
an8.86:1.4: ‘samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto Icchānaṅgale viharati Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an8.86:1.5: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
an8.86:1.6: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho . . . pe . . .
an8.86:1.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī' ti.
an8.86:2.1: Atha kho Icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ ādāya yena Icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bahi dvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā. 3.
an8.86:2.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Nāgito Bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
an8.86:2.3: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Nāgitaṃ āmantesi:--
an8.86:2.4: Ke pana te Nāgita uccāsaddā mahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macche vilope' ti?
an8.86:2.5: ‘Ete bhante Icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ ādāya bahi dvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā Bhagavantaṃ yeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañ cā' ti.
an8.86:2.6: Māhaṃ Nāgita yasena samāgamaṃ mā ca mayā yaso;
an8.86:2.7: yo kho Nāgita na yimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an8.86:2.8: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā ti.
an8.86:3.3: yena yen' eva dāni bhante Bhagavā gamissati, tanninnā' va bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca.
an8.86:3.4: Seyyathā pi bhante thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti,
an8.86:3.5: evam eva kho bhante yena yen' eva dāni Bhagavā gamissati, tanninnā 'va bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā c' eva jānapadā ca.
an8.86:3.7: Tathā hi bhante Bhagavato sīlapaññāṇan' ti.
an8.86:4.1: Māhaṃ Nāgita yasena samāgamaṃ mā ca mayā yaso;
an8.86:4.2: yo kho Nāgita na yimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an8.86:4.3: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
an8.86:5.1: Devatā pi kho Nāgita ekaccā na yimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhiniyo assu akicchalābhiniyo akasiralābhiniyo, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an8.86:5.2: Tumhākam pi kho Nāgita saṃgamma samāgamma saṅgaṇikavihāraṃ anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ evaṃ hoti:
an8.86:5.3: na ha nūna 'me āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī;
an8.86:5.4: tathā hi 'me āyasmanto saṃgamma samāgamma saṅgaṇikavihāraṃ anuyuttā viharanti. 4.
an8.86:6.1: Idhāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhū passāmi aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghante saṃkīḷante.
an8.86:6.3: na ha nūna 'me āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī;
an8.86:6.4: tathā hi 'me āyasmanto aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghanti saṃkīḷanti. 5.
an8.86:7.1: Idhāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhū passāmi yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ phassasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutte viharante.
an8.86:7.3: na ha nūna 'me āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī;
an8.86:7.4: tathā hi 'me āyasmanto yavadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ phassasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyuttā viharanti. 6.
an8.86:8.1: Idhāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāriṃ samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an8.86:8.3: ‘idāni imaṃ āyasmantaṃ ārāmiko vā saccessati samaṇuddeso vā, taṃ tamhā samādhimhā cāvissatī' ti.
an8.86:8.4: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena. 7.
an8.86:9.1: Idha panāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ araññe pacalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an8.86:9.3: ‘idāni ayam āyasmā imaṃ niddākilamathaṃ paṭivinodetvā araññasaññaṃ yeva manasikarissati ekattan' ti.
an8.86:9.4: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena. 8.
an8.86:10.1: Idha panāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ araññe asamāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an8.86:10.3: ‘idāni ayam āyasmā asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādahissati samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī' ti.
an8.86:10.4: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena. 9.
an8.86:11.1: Idha panāhaṃ Nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ araññe samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an8.86:11.3: ‘idāni ayam āyasmā avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccissati vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī' ti.
an8.86:13.3: Tenāhaṃ Nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
an8.86:14.1: Yasmāhaṃ Nāgita samaye addhānamaggapaṭipanno na kiñci passāmi purato vā pacchato vā, phāsu me Nāgita tasmiṃ samaye hoti antamaso uccārapassāvakammāyā
